name: Langkawi International Half Marathon 2026
short_description: Langkawi International Half Marathon 2026 is on Saturday 12 December 2026 at Mahsuri International Exhibition Centre (MIEC) in Langkawi, over 21.1 km.
ai_summary: The Langkawi International Half Marathon 2026 is the fifth edition, organised by the Langkawirunners club from the Mahsuri International Exhibition Centre (MIEC), Langkawi, on Saturday 12 December 2026. It is a 21 km-only race, and the organiser describes the course as running along sunrise paddy-field roads. The event runs from 5:00 am to 11:30 am, with race kit collection at Lagenda Beach on 10 and 11 December.

faqs.question: What day and time is the Langkawi International Half Marathon 2026?
faqs.answer: It is on Saturday 12 December 2026, not a Sunday, at the Mahsuri International Exhibition Centre (MIEC). The event window is 5:00 am to 11:30 am.

faqs.question: Where do runners collect race kits?
faqs.answer: Race kit collection is at Lagenda Beach on 10 and 11 December 2026. Collection hours are 9:00 am to 6:30 pm on both days.
